reviews.review:
Very good Aliens game, the most Aliens an Aliens game has been. Except for at the end.... 
[spoiler] You don't get to fight the Queen WTF!? [/spoiler]

This can be a fun, Gears of War like experience in the Aliens universe but this comes with some major caveats and I don't recommend it as a fan of the franchise for the following reasons.

For one, all the maps are boring and lackluster. The level design and lack of diversity is a real end-game killer. By the time you're at the place where you need to 'do runs / grind ' to level up, its off putting and mind numbing. Levels are not fun. Having multiple routes and adding even a basic level of player choice it could've been spiced up. The DLC doubles down on this effect.

For two, the AI is probably the worst I've seen in a game in 15+ years. A 5 year old child with down syndrome under the influence of half a keg of premium German beer would certainly be preferable. Line up a long distance shot? Don't mind the AI immediately walking in front and blocking you. Under intense fire? They'll ignore your need for help, shoot you in the back, and are a liability on every level and difficulty. 

For three, there's the Alien Queen but you can't fight her - and it's just as much of a tease as the power loader on the station that you can see - but never use / unlock etc. SO MANY MISSED CHANCES to give fans great service here and its f-u-c-k-i-n-g tragic.

The DLC's for this are mostly a cash grab with cosmetics, and even the added 3 levels aren't worth the cost since they're more of the same boring level design.

Bullet sponge enemies, boring levels, and poor mechanics ultimately make this title lame. While there is a ton of positive to be said about the sound track, class and weapon design, and cool factor, all of it is outweighed by the negative. As a huge fan of the series, this could have been so much more. Sad pass.
Great game just wish they'd add more maps, missions, quests and more more more !
If you like the franchise it will keep you entertained.
UNLESS YOU HAVE TIKTOK READILY AVAILABLE, DO NOT BUY THIS.
